turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Yaar, tujhe lagta hai ki tu uski flight book kar de? Mujhe lagta hai ki theek hai, kyunki shaadi ke liye sab kuch plan karna padta hai. Lekin, Rohan ko pata hona chahiye ki tu uske liye flight book kar raha hai. Bas, usse ek baar pata kar le, kyunki agar woh koi aur plan bana raha ho, to fir problem ho sakti hai. Toh, pehle usse baat kar, phir decide karna.

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Yaar, lagta hai Rohan thoda busy hai, lekin uska bahut kam interact karna thoda tension de raha hai. Startup mein job karna challenging hota hai, to ho sakta hai wo really busy ho. Lekin, shaadi ka mamla hai, to usse personally baat kar, samajh aayega. Agar tu khud hi flight book kar de, to usse pata kar ke bata dena, taaki woh prepare ho sake. Aur, agar uska mood thoda off hai, to usse chill karne ko bol, shaadi ke liye relaxed rahega.

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Yaar, tujhe lag raha hai ki Rohan care nahi kar raha, par ho sakta hai wo apne kaam mein itna busy ho ki usse samay na mil raha ho. Lekin, seedha puchhna theek hai, kyunki tujhe pata chalega ki wo aa raha hai ya nahi. Agar wo "nahi" bhi bole, to behtar hai ki tujhe pata chal jaye. Call karke puchhna theek rahega, bas chill rahena, shaadi ke liye stress na le. Phir, uske jawab ke according tu apna plan bana sakta hai.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Yaar, tujhe lag raha hai ki kuch badla hai Rohan mein, aur yeh baat sach hai ki pehle woh itna active tha. Lekin, ab uska job switch aur startup ka pressure ho sakta hai reason. Ho sakta hai uska focus ab work par ho, aur personal life pe zyada dhyan na de pa raha ho. Tujhe apni fiancée ki baat bhi sochni chahiye, wo keh rahi hai ki tu overthink kar raha hai. Phir bhi, jab tu usse call kar ke puchhega, to situation clear ho jayegi. Agar wo "nahi" bhi kahe, to tujhe pata chal jayega aur tu apna plan set kar sakta hai. Naraaz hone se pehle, ek baar chill kar ke baat kar, shaadi ke liye positivity rakh.
